title: My Kid's Bully is Hilarious | Gary Michael Anderson | Stand Up Comedy
description:
Gary Anderson on being listening to his son's problems, married to a white woman, and having good flight etiquette

Comedy is at its best when there's a surprise – that's why Don't Tell Comedy puts on events where the performers and location are kept secret until the day of the show. With over 200 cities already in on the joke, you never know where we'll set up shop, or who might pop in. Want to be let in on the secret? Visit our website below to find an upcoming show near you: https://www.donttellcomedy.com

Just don't tell anyone!! 🤫

-----------------------------------------------------------

Winner of the 2023 San Francisco International Comedy Competition, Gary was a staff writer for the two-time Emmy-nominated The Ms. Pat Show (BET+) and wrote and acted in BFFs (Freevee/Amazon Prime). He also co-hosts the podcast Wildly Inappropriate on YouTube. After sharpening his skills in San Francisco, he now performs regularly in Los Angeles—still chasing the dream of one day having someone else write his bio.
